relationships.subject: mitochondrial electron transport chain
relationships.evidence_quote: Therefore, increasing ETC biogenesis weakened the resilience of TRPV1+ nociceptors to excitotoxicity.

key_findings: Genome-wide CRISPRi screen shows that suppressing the mitochondrial electron transport chain protects against TRPV1-mediated capsaicin excitotoxicity by lowering NAD+/NADH-dependent calcium influx and by reducing complex III-derived mitochondrial ROS.
TRPV1+ sensory neurons are more resilient to excitotoxic and oxidative challenge than other DRG neuron subtypes, consistent with intrinsically tuned ETC expression.
